name: Tebex
line: Merchant of record for game servers, mods, and digital creator goods.

free.text: Starter has no monthly fee; standard platform rate is 5%

cells.payout: PayPal settlement 7+ days; card settlement up to 14 days

fee.math: The card payment fee is 2.49%, plus a 5% platform fee for most games. For FiveM, the rate is 15%. The fixed fee and currency aren't clear.
